label: Lab 03
title: Failover
question: When the database server a company writes to fails, which keeps the company's writes better: MongoDB or PostgreSQL?
how: We stop the main database server in the middle of a working session, on purpose, and check which writes it had confirmed are still there afterwards. Each side's advocate wrote down what they expect before anything ran.
status: Measured on one host; strict-ack and overlap limits remain
